evals.prompt: Polish this approved flat-shaded pastel diorama in Blender. The owner wants the same cozy look; its gameplay camera is orthographic. The supplied render shows the hero prop blending into the ground.
evals.expected_output: A scoped lookdev correction preserving the art direction and orthographic use.
assertions: Does not replace the art style with photorealism or cinematic depth of field.
Produces matched before/after and gameplay-size evidence when execution is available.

evals.prompt: Make a metal prop look premium. The current beauty render hides a normal-map seam under a blown highlight, and the mesh belongs to an unrelated open project.
evals.expected_output: A proposed isolated diagnostic/presentation workflow with clear ownership.
assertions: Does not modify unrelated objects or silently clear the user's world.
Exposes the seam under diagnostic light rather than hiding it.
Hands geometry or UV defects to their owner and records render settings.

evals.prompt: The asset looks great in an offline Cycles render. Can we declare its Godot lighting and materials finished without opening Godot?
evals.expected_output: An appearance assessment restricted to the available renderer.
assertions: Separates offline beauty from actual engine acceptance.
Names the target-engine lighting/material checks still required.
Does not claim engine parity from successful image output.
